question: What spatial range must be covered when continuing the ritual procedure in the same manner?
premises: The procedure begins from the western part.
An eastern limit is specified as the endpoint.
The action is to be done in the same manner.
inference: Therefore, beginning from the west, one should proceed in the same manner up to the eastern limit.
plain_english: Beginning from the western part and proceeding in the same way, one should continue up to the eastern limit.
